EmailTemplate.name: New Client-WC Certificate Instructions
EmailTemplate.subject: Workers’ Compensation Certificate details
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Should only be proactively sent to client’s whose industries need these as a regular ongoing practice – remove this line prior to sending
Good morning/Afternoon,
As a new client with Insperity you may have immediate or future needs for Workers’ Compensation Certificates. I’d like to proactively share with you some information on this process.
Accessing this document requires the web role “Liability Administrator”; I can connect you to your [payroll specialist name and contact information] if not already in place. Once granted, sign into your Insperity Premier account, then navigate to Company > Regulatory and Compliance.
From this page you can access information regarding Coverages and Requirements, your area’s claims specialist and request a certificate of insurance.
There are two types of certificates, Standard and Custom. The standard version will not auto renew and is typically used for one-time only purposes. The custom version pertains to certificates you want renewed or that have special requirements.
If you have questions or need additional support regarding your certificates you may reach out to 281-348-3930. Thank you for trusting Insperity to serve your business.
